files.agents/agent.yaml:
name: agent
ai:
  model: openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4
  thinking_level: max
  options:
    max_tokens: 4096
    future_request_policy:
      mode: strict
  providers:
    openrouter:
      routing:
        future_router_policy:
          mode: strict
    anthropic:
      context_management:
        edits: []
    vercel_ai_gateway:
      routing:
        future_gateway_policy:
          mode: strict
session:
  steering_mode: one-at-a-time
  follow_up_mode: all
  tool_execution: parallel
  retry:
    enabled: true
    max_retries: 3
    base_delay_ms: 2000
    max_agent_delay_ms: 60000
    provider:
      timeout_ms: 30000
      max_retries: 2
      max_retry_delay_ms: 60000
  compaction:
    enabled: true
    reserve_tokens: 16384
    keep_recent_tokens: 20000
  images:
    auto_resize: true
    block_images: false
